page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel processing workloads. Built on x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM virtualization, it provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance contains no local storage, requiring attached network storage for persistent operational data. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provided.

This server offers efficient hardware density for single-GPU acceleration tasks. A tradeoff includes reliance on network-attached storage due to the absence of integrated local drives. Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is suited for machine learning inference, video encoding, computer vision processing, and general media transcoding jobs.
